title: Malaysian Pork Satay
description: A flavorful and spicy satay dish originating from Malaysia, featuring marinated pork tenderloin.

ingredients.name: satay skewers
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for at least 30 minutes

instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine coconut sugar, coriander, cumin, garlic, and salt to make the spice paste.
2. Trim any excess fat from the pork tenderloin and cut it into 1-inch pieces.
3. In a large bowl, mix together the spice paste, coconut milk, and spicy peanut sauce.
4. Add the pork pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
6. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
7. Thread the marinated pork onto the satay skewers.
8. Brush the grill with peanut oil to prevent sticking.
9. Cook the satay for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the meat is cooked through.
10. Serve immediately with additional spicy peanut sauce for dipping.
